routing.forbiddenOrigin: CORS adds no allow-origin header and continues. Protected mutations later return 403 from requireAllowedOrigin; OPTIONS falls through to Express routing semantics.
routing.wrongMethod: Express routing result is contractual; do not replace a baseline 404/implicit OPTIONS response with Spring's default 405.

json-admin-private.cacheControl: private, no-store once requireAdmin executes; parser/CORS errors that happen earlier do not inherit it

cookieContracts.otherRoutes: No Set-Cookie; successful session lookup renews expiresAt only in sessions.json.
